snippet.title: Memory's Reach demo trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Memory’s Reach is a first person puzzle-adventure metroidvania. Explore labyrinthian megastructures, solve mind-bending puzzles, and wield fantastic alien technology in a quest to reveal the legacy of a doomed civilization.

Memory's Reach by @100stonesinteractive  has an updated demo out!

Memory's Reach in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/memorys-reach/
Memory's Reach on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2126810/Memorys_Reach/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
